Foes

Bestiary

Ten thousand creatures, one thousand in each landscape, from base level 1 to 80. The numbers here are the written bodies. A live map multiplies them for your stage, your level, and the biome — see Combat for that curve. Early levels are also given extra HP so they survive a swing.

How to read a row

Species is the loot table (slime, mammal, undead, and fourteen others). Type is the creature you see: Wolf, Slime, Dragon. Habitat is where that body is allowed to appear. Skills are their own book, not your class tree. One thousand foes are filed under each of the ten landscapes, so a forest wolf and an Aetherium wolf are different entries.

Search a fragment. “enraged slime” or “atherium” both work. The habitat menu narrows a landscape before you type.
